name: Bent-Over Barbell Deadlift

instructions.description: Stand with feet hip width apart and the barbell over the middle of your feet.
Hinge at the hips, bend the knees enough to grasp the bar, and set your back flat with your chest open.
Push the floor away and extend your hips and knees together until you stand tall with the bar close to your body.
Lower the bar by hinging at the hips first and keeping it close to the legs until it returns to the floor.

performanceMetrics.notes: Each repetition should start from a strong setup position.
Use a load that preserves spinal alignment.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use a kettlebell between the feet to simplify setup.

commentsNotes: Do not round the back to reach the bar.
Stop if you cannot keep the bar close to the body.
